cueCard.topic: Describe a time when you had to be very polite.
cueCard.explain: and explain why you had to be so polite.

questions.text: Describe a time when you had to be very polite.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you had to be very polite. You should say: when it was; where you were; who you were with; and explain why you had to be so polite.

questions.text: Was it easy for you to be polite in that situation?
questions.say: Thank you. Was it easy for you to be polite in that situation?

questions.text: Who should teach children good manners, parents or teachers?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you had to be very polite, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all manners. Who should teach children good manners, parents or teachers?

questions.text: Are good manners the same in every country?

questions.text: Do you think young people today are less polite than in the past?

questions.text: Why is politeness important at work?
questions.say: Now let's talk about politeness in society. Why is politeness important at work?

questions.text: Are people more polite in small towns than in big cities?
